message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are visible in the code; data is passed directly from upload into the cluster_solver function without validation.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code does not fetch data from any remote source; it appears to rely on user file uploads via Streamlit, and no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks are implemented.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the visible code.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is implemented on the uploaded dataset before clustering or classification.

No detected model integrity verification: The code uses pickle.dumps for serialization/download but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading any pretrained weights or serialized models.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, trigger detection, or gradient anomaly detection present anywhere in the visible code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation; the code focuses on clustering and downloading results without such controls.
No detected input sanitization: The code uploads and passes data directly into the cluster_solver function without any shape, range, type, or schema validation on the incoming DataFrame.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs such as NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or threshold validation visible in the provided code slice.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses clustering and classification models (KMeans, RandomForest, etc.), not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and not present.
